notes: Near-black monochrome dev-tool aesthetic (Vercel/Geist feel). The hero IS the product: a send panel with mono 'SEND' label, live latency (9MS) and green READY dot, and a dashed dropzone. Nav is a floating rounded pill with hairline border, vertical separators between groups, scrollspy highlighting the active section, and a solid white GitHub pill as the only filled button. Each section repeats the formula: tiny letterspaced mono eyebrow (light blue tint), 36px two-line heading left, muted paragraph right, hairline divider above. Privacy section uses → vs ✕ ruled lists. CLI section pairs OS tabs + copyable install command with an animated terminal transcript including ASCII progress bars and green 'Connected (direct)'. White pill CTAs only. Copy voice is plain and precise ('No asterisks. The fine print, printed large.').
